violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils can opener and knives at the knife rack were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener and knives were moved to the ware washing area at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

Various food was observed held between 43-48 degrees Fahrenheit in prep unit #2. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food was evaluated at the time of inspection and either voluntarily disposed of or moved to properly functioning refrigeration at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to use prep unit #2 until it is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or lower. Service was called at the time of inspection. Cheese was observed held at 50 degrees Fahrenheit in prep unit #3. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Cheese was observed being stored above the fill-line and voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

ROP Mahi-Mahi and salmon was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. Mahi-Mahi was observed at 32 DF, and salmon was observed at 33 DF. All fish was completely taken out of packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The door to the outside, located in the outside walk-in cooler and liquor walk-in cooler, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of sauce. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

-The 2 door lowboy was observed non-operational and holding an ambient temperature of 60 DF -Prep unit #2 was observed holding an ambient temperature of 47 DF and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026
Establishment is lacking drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and prep units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

The floor in the kitchen area and under equipment has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the bar area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Soap was provided at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

At the time of inspection, raw calamari were observed stored behind cooked chicken wings in the cookline prep cooler. Raw animal foods are to be stored properly to prevent cross-contamination/cross-contact. Foods were rearranged for proper storage at the time of inspection (Cooked wings relocated behind raw calamari). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

Chicken wings were observed in the cookline prep unit at 43-45 degrees Fahrenheit. Based on time of opening and constant use of the prep unit, chicken wings were moved to colder refrigeration for rapid cooling and swapped with cold wings from the same batch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

Chemical spray bottles were observed stored hanging from the kitchen splash guard. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Spray bottles were moved for proper storage at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

Frozen packages of food items were observed thawing in standing water in the food prep sink. Proper thawing of frozen foods was discussed with staff at time of inspection. Thawed items were moved to refrigeration, and the faucet was turned on for remaining items at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025
The gasket to the exterior walk-in cooler door was observed not sealing entirely. Gasket to the W/I cooler door is to be adjusted or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025
